fill.obs_text: The lexicon entries bear the grouping out for the codes of the mind and the argument, and show the rest as grounds. The codes of reasoning are G1256 (to reason, discuss, argue; 7 occurrences), G1261 (thought, argument; 1) and G3049 (to reckon, consider; 1). The codes of ground or cause are G0156 (cause, charge; 4), H1697M (word, matter; 2), H6440I (face, the sense of before or because of; 2), H2600 (without cause; 2), G1352 (therefore; 1) and G5484 (because of; 2), with the small words that stand in their units: G1223 (through, because of; 4), G1519 (to, toward; 1), H5921A (upon, on account of; 2), G2596 (according to; 1), H3651C (so, therefore; 1), G0302 (a word of condition; 1) and G5124 (that thing; 3). H4486 (knowledge, power of knowing; 2) is the mind's faculty, G2138 (compliant, easily persuaded; 1) a stance toward persuasion, G3056 (word, matter; 1) the account asked for a hope, H3198 (to prove, rebuke; 1) the arguing of a case, and H1961 (to be, to come about; 1) is the cause of a fruitfulness in a figure. The codes that link the group to its usage are G1256, G1261, G3049, H3198 and H4486 for the mind's reasoning, and G0156, H1697M, H6440I, H2600, G1352 and G5484 for the ground given.
